name: Do I need a building permit for interior framing projects in Aurora and Denver?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit for interior framing projects in Aurora and Denver?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most interior framing for residential remodels requires a municipal building permit, particularly when removing walls, altering room configurations, building additions, or finishing a basement. Partition walls alter egress routes, fire blocking, and room dimensions, and they trigger electrical or plumbing rough-ins that must be inspected. Even non-load-bearing changes typically need plan review to verify building code compliance. During a project, Abraham Becerra coordinates directly with local building departments across Aurora and the Denver area to ensure framed layouts satisfy municipal codes before closing up walls with insulation and drywall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, permits are typically required for interior framing changes, basement finishes, and wall alterations to confirm safety, egress, and local building code compliance.
